revision_summary: Two quote timestamp errors must be corrected in script_coverage: (1) the roof section's customer quote 'Shingle. Yeah.' is timestamped 01:43 but actually occurs at 02:06-02:08 (01:43 is the rep's tall-trees line) — fix the ts. (2) the bill_collection section's customer quote 'I would have to get on the site and look. I don't have anything.' is timestamped 03:28 but actually occurs at 03:55-04:02 (03:28 is the rep asking about bill format) — fix the ts. Both are timestamp/attribution slips rather than fabrications (words exist verbatim elsewhere in the transcript), so no rerun of the full analysis is needed — just correct the two ts fields. Additionally, on rerun: (a) flag the credit-threshold line at 02:29 ('above 6 170') against the schema's qualifiers.credit_qualifier drift-tracking mechanism (threshold is 670, and the schema explicitly documents prior drift and asks Stewart to flag reconciliation cases) — this was skipped entirely; (b) classify the rep's offer to receive the bill at his personal email (05:56-06:11) against bill_collection.stewart_automated_bill_capture's detection_today anti-pattern for personal-contact bill collection, since it presents the same privacy/scale-exposure concern the schema calls out for personal phone numbers. Outcome dispute is well-supported and should be kept as-is.
